title: Fix all CI build and test failures
body:
CI on main is red: console build fails with 20+ TypeScript errors, and 2 test failures in ListColumnExtensions.

### Build fixes

- **ListView.tsx** — `qf.id` accessed on `QuickFilterItem` union where `SpecQuickFilterItem` has no `id`. Use `normalizeQuickFilter()` before accessing:
  ```ts
  const normalized = normalizeQuickFilter(qf);
  if (normalized.defaultActive) defaults.add(normalized.id);
  ```
- **ListView.tsx** — Missing required `collapsed` field in grouping config: `{ field: field.name, order: 'asc', collapsed: false }`
- **ListView.tsx** — Implicit `any` on `.map(w => ...)` callback, added `: string`
- **config-field-renderer.tsx** — Unused `objectDef` param → prefixed with `_`
- **Story files** — `StoryObj<typeof meta>` requires args when component has required props; switched to `StoryObj<typeof Component>`
- **Example configs** — `@objectstack/spec@3.0.9` input types don't allow `type` on dashboards or `id` on widgets (these are stripped/generated by `defineStack()` at runtime). Removed from all three example configs.

### Test fixes

- **ListColumnExtensions.test.tsx** — Tests expected action column buttons with name `'active'` (the cell value), but implementation renders `formatActionLabel('toggleStatus')` → `'ToggleStatus'`. Updated assertions to match.
- **crm-metadata.test.ts** — Removed test for `CrmDashboard.type` and updated widget `id` uniqueness test to use `title` (since `id` was removed from the definition).
